name: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots
description:
End Phase: Deals 1 Anemo DMG if your active character is Dendro or Geo; otherwise, deals 1 DMG of that character's Elemental Type. Heal the character on your team that has taken the most damage for 2 HP.
Usage(s): 2
